sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Fresh clean source build passes, CTest has no registered tests; --restart is parsed but never loaded and written state lacks BDF histories/time.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: CGNS unstructured reader, boundary tags, geometry and cell-face graph construction are source-evidenced; mixed/multi-zone behavior is not executed.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Conservative assembly, Riemann options, farfield/slip/no-slip branches and viscous wall path are present; no numerical verification is available.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: Least-squares reconstruction, Barth limiter and positivity fallback are present; production accuracy cannot be demonstrated and fallbacks are material.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: Newtonian/Fourier flux and wall shear exist, but solver.cpp:650–667 counts full traction including normal stress as viscous force; rubric requires tangential skin friction.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: BDF2 structure exists; checkpoint stdout reports 11356 strict misses while metadata reports zero, and report claims an absolute convergence branch absent from source revision. Historic binary remains unbound.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: METIS/neighbor halos exist, but main.cpp retains complete global mesh on every rank through solve; TASK.md:46,227 prohibit this. Rank package review pending.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Recovered eight cases show two NACA configurations with partial credible results; M015 inviscid/laminar and Re20 oscillate strongly despite success labels, M200 laminar remains unsettled and Re200 has no resolved street/11356 reported misses. Field and rank evidence exists.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Nine-page contestant checkpoint PDF and standalone figures exist despite curated-build absence. It documents methods and no Re200 street, but reports a nonexistent absolute acceptance criterion, has stale force values, and manifest assigns force plots to VTK data.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Separated modules and JSON case input support extension; header-only single-TU architecture and case-specific report/commands limit it.
